scripts.migrate: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply api --remote
scripts.migrate:local: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply api --local
scripts.db:setup: npm run migrate:local && npm run dev
scripts.db:reset: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('.wrangler/state/v3/d1', { recursive: true, force: true })" && npm run migrate:local
scripts.db:tables: npx wrangler d1 execute api --local --command "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' ORDER BY name"
